title: Frog Fungus Put 501 Amphibian Species In A Survival Crisis
hook: A single fungus erased species and keeps pushing others down.
closing: This fungus is still reshaping amphibian survival long after the first extinctions.
question: Should frog recovery get more funding?

segments.say: The fungus affected 501 amphibian species, creating a survival crisis on a global scale.
The fungus leaves 39 percent of affected species still declining, so the crisis is not over.
The fungus hit 40 Australian frog species, proving even isolated ecosystems were not safe.
